Pseudo-code:

```
def build_milp(N):
    import cvxpy as cp
    x = cp.Variable(N, boolean=True)
    constraints = [cp.sum(x) == N//2]
    C = cp.Variable()
    for ell in range(1,N):
        length = N - ell
        if length == 0:
            continue
        H = cp.sum(x[:length])    # sum of first length entries
        # product variables
        y = cp.Variable(length, boolean=True)
        constraints += [y <= x[:length],
                        y <= x[ell:],
                        y >= x[:length] + x[ell:] - 1]
        O = cp.sum(y)
        c = H - O
        constraints += [c <= C,
                        c >= 0]
    # minimize C
    prob = cp.Problem(cp.Minimize(C), constraints)
    return prob, x, C
```
